one_liner: Google Ads API is a free, broad API (gRPC, REST) with OAuth2; production use requires per-Cloud-project access-level approval (Explorer is mostly automated), and an official MCP server exists.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user authorization via a self-serve Google Cloud project OAuth client is the standard method; service accounts are also supported. Developer tokens were sunset and access levels are tied to the Cloud project.
access_notes: The API is free. Test access is immediate on enabling the API. Explorer access is mostly automated but capped at 2,880 operations/day on production accounts. Basic and Standard need review (brand verification; Standard needs RMF).
blocker_notes: Production use needs Explorer/Basic/Standard access via Google's review. Test accounts and Test access allow building and testing meanwhile.

The Google Ads API is free to use; there are no charges for using the Google Ads API at Explorer access, Basic access, or Standard access levels.
We use **OAuth 2.0** for authenticating your requests against the API.
If you use the [service account workflow](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/oauth/service-accounts), then this is the project that owns your service account.
Google provides officially supported client libraries that handle authentication, serialization, and communication with the gRPC endpoints.
Use webhook to send data from Google Ads to your CRM system.

We have published updated versions of [the client libraries](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/client-libs), the [Google Ads MCP server](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/developer-toolkit/mcp-server)
